description:
Job Title: Appian Developer - Mid 
 
Job Category: Engineering 
 
Time Type: Full time 
 
Minimum Clearance Required to Start: None 
 
Employee Type: Regular 
 
Percentage of Travel Required: Up to 25% 
 
Type of Travel: Continental US 
 
* * * 
 
 
 The Opportunity: 
CACI is preparing for an exciting modernization effort with the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA). This new program will be a transformational initiative that will reshape how the VA manages acquisition, contracting, and enterprise-wide data. As the VA moves toward a modern, secure, and integrated CMS environment, our team will play a pivotal role in delivering the technology, expertise, and innovative problem solving required to support the nation’s veterans.
  
 CACI is building a team of experts who thrive in challenging modernization environments as this program calls for high-impact technical leaders, forward-thinking engineers and mission-focused professionals. We are currently hiring an Appian Developer to join this dynamic team.

 The Appian Developer will design, develop, and maintain Appian-based applications within Agile delivery pods supporting a Federal enterprise acquisition system modernization. This role requires strong technical skills in low-code platform development, experience with process automation and integrations, and the ability to work collaboratively with business analysts and technical teams to deliver scalable solutions serving 26,000+ users transitioning to a unified Appian-based platform.

 This position is contingent upon contract award. 

 Key Responsibilities 
 Design and develop Appian applications including process models, interfaces, records, sites, integrations, and expression rules to meet Federal acquisition requirements
 Build and maintain Appian Connected Systems and Integration Objects to enable system-to-system data exchange with financial systems, Federal platforms, and internal applications
 Develop reusable components, data types, and expression rules to accelerate delivery and promote code consistency across delivery pods
 Collaborate with Appian Configuration Analysts, business analysts, and subject matter experts to translate business requirements into technical solutions
 Participate in Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, daily standups, demos, and retrospectives, contributing to sprint commitments and velocity
 Conduct unit testing, code reviews, and support integration testing, UAT, and defect resolution activities
 Optimize application performance through efficient query design, caching strategies, and Appian best practices
 Develop and maintain technical documentation including design specifications, API documentation, and deployment procedures
 Support deployment activities including application packaging, environment promotion, and release validation
 Mentor junior developers on Appian development best practices, design patterns, and Federal acquisition domain knowledge
 
 Qualifications
 Required 
 US citizen with ability to pass Tier 2 background investigation
 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related technical field of study (3+ additional years of relevant IT experience may be considered in lieu of degree)
 3-7 years of experience in software development, with at least 1 year of Appian development or low-code platform experience (Two levels:  mid-career = 3-5 years of experience; lead-level = 5+ years of experience)
 Experience developing applications using low-code/no-code platforms or business process management tools
 Strong understanding of software development lifecycle, object-oriented programming concepts, and database design
 Proficiency with web services, APIs, or system integration development
 Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to code quality and maintainability
 
 Desired 
 Appian Certified Associate Developer or Appian Certified Senior Developer certification
 Hands-on experience developing Appian applications (process models, interfaces, records, sites, integrations, expression rules)
 Experience supporting Federal government system modernization programs
 Knowledge of Federal acquisition lifecycle, contracting processes, or FAR/VAAR regulations
 Advanced SQL skills for database querying, optimization, and stored procedure development
 Prior experience with Agile/Scrum methodologies and sprint-based delivery
 Programming experience (Java, JavaScript, Python) for advanced Appian customizations or extensions
 Familiarity with Azure cloud environments, SaaS application development, or containerization
 Experience with RESTful APIs, SOAP web services, or enterprise integration patterns
 Understanding of DevSecOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, and automated testing
 Background in user experience design or Section 508 accessibility standards
 Experience with data migration, ETL processes, or data transformation logic 
 
 
 
- 
 

 What You Can Expect: 
  A culture of integrity. 
 At CACI, we place character and innovation at the center of everything we do. As a valued team member, you’ll be part of a high-performing group dedicated to our customer’s missions and driven by a higher purpose – to ensure the safety of our nation.
 An environment of trust. 
 CACI values the unique contributions that every employee brings to our company and our customers - every day. You’ll have the autonomy to take the time you need through a unique flexible time off benefit and have access to robust learning resources to make your ambitions a reality.
 A focus on continuous growth. 
 Together, we will advance our nation's most critical missions, build on our lengthy track record of business success, and find opportunities to break new ground — in your career and in our legacy.
 
 

 Pay Range : 
 There are a host of factors that can influence final salary including, but not limited to, geographic location, Federal Government contract labor categories and contract wage rates, relevant prior work experience, specific skills and competencies, education, and certifications. Our employees value the flexibility at CACI that allows them to balance quality work and their personal lives. We offer competitive compensation, benefits and learning and development opportunities. Our broad and competitive mix of benefits options is designed to support and protect employees and their families. At CACI, you will receive comprehensive benefits such as; healthcare, wellness, financial, retirement, family support, continuing education, and time off benefits.
 
 Since this position can be worked in more than one location, the range shown is the national average for the position.
 
 The proposed salary range for this position is: 
$69,100-$141,500 
 
 CACI is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected characteristic.
